name: Magic Rings
description: WebGL2 background of glowing concentric rings that pulse, ripple or breathe, with optional tilt, prism dispersion, grain, mouse follow and click bursts. Fills its parent container.
contents: Container div with a transparent full-size WebGL canvas
Up to 12 glowing rings blending between two colors
behavior: Rings animate in one of three motions and play an intro fade-in on first mount
Rings tilt and shift with the pointer through parallax, and optionally follow the mouse with hover glow
Clicking or tapping spawns up to 3 expanding burst rings
Pauses rendering when off screen or tab hidden, and skips the intro under reduced motion
editableByProps: Two ring colors, ring count, radius, spacing and taper
Motion style, speed, line thickness, glow, opacity, rotation, spin and 3D tilt
Mouse follow, hover, parallax, click bursts and intro
Light theme for light backgrounds, pixel ratio cap, container className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Allow more than 12 rings or more than 3 simultaneous bursts
needsCodeEdit.where: MAX_RINGS and MAX_BURSTS constants at the top of the file

needsCodeEdit.change: Change pulse timing of the rings

needsCodeEdit.where: MOTIONS array and the ripple/breathe branches in the frame function

fixed: Requires WebGL2, renders nothing if unavailable
Fills the parent, so the parent needs a defined height
Canvas has pointer-events none, pointer input is read from window listeners over the whole page
Listens to window pointer events and document visibility while mounted
Ring count is capped at 12 and bursts at 3
Uses a 3D-style canvas, heavy on low-end mobile GPUs; lower maxDevicePixelRatio there
Rendering is transparent so the background behind it shows through

options.look: Rings fade in and out in staggered pulses while expanding outward
Wave travels across the ring set like ripples on water
Rings gently swell and contract in a slow wave
